purpose: Reference metadata for simulator alignment. These numbers constrain data cadence/provenance; they do not prove One-Wave physics or define a physical lattice spacing.

cern_cms.source_kind: browser-readable event display derived from CMS AOD

cern_tracker_hit_reference.source_kind: CMS simulated collision samples with tracker-hit positions in custom ROOT ntuples
cern_tracker_hit_reference.caveat: Useful for detector-geometry and transform testing; record 12220 is simulated data, not recorded collision data.

locked_boundaries: Do not derive physical lattice spacing from 8 TeV or 125 GeV without an independent derivation.
Do not interpret reconstructed particle labels as simulator primitives.
Keep measured/raw values immutable beside transformed values.
Frequency octave analysis and geometric/amplitude scaling are separate operations.
